newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar tightly mixed, lacks news.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar tightly mixed, lacks news.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was tightly mixed by late morning, in thin, directionless trade, with the focus still on August and October.
By 1010 GMT August was 10 cents lower at $326.60. October was 10 lower at $326.60, while October was 10 cents higher at $317.00.
Market players were getting ready for August to go off the board, one trader said. "People are tidying up positions," he said.
A lack of any market-moving fundamental news meant that there was little direction, he said.
But there was some selling on December, ahead of the EU's tender on Wednesday. December fell $1.20 to $313.60.
The European Union's 1996/97 sugar export target could be achieved following a recent upsurge in trade demand, Commission officials said on Tuesday.
With three more tenders before the current export campaign closes on July 30, the EU still has 232,000 tonnes of sugar to export to meet its target.
"It could still be done. We have the technical possibility to complete the programme," a Commission official said. --Christopher Lyddon, London newsroom +44 171 542 7928
